e2eTests.notes: E2E tests deferred. Critical user journeys (blog list, post detail 404, RSS feed) are fully covered by integration tests using Django TestClient. Browser-level e2e tests are not required for this backend-only phase.

defectLog.description: GetPostBySlug use case used request_user_authenticated (any logged-in user) to gate draft post access. Client portal users are authenticated Django users and would have been able to view unpublished draft posts via the public URL.
defectLog.resolution: Changed check from request_user_authenticated to request_user_is_staff in both the use case (use_cases.py) and the view (views.py). Updated integration tests to verify non-staff authenticated users receive 404 on drafts.

owaspFindings.finding: FIXED - Draft post information disclosure via public URL for authenticated non-staff users. Fixed by requiring is_staff.
PASS - No sensitive data stored in plaintext. API keys and DB credentials loaded exclusively from environment variables via django-environ.

PASS - All ORM queries use Django's parameterized query system. Supabase embedding service uses psycopg2 with %s placeholders. Slug input validated by strict regex before reaching the ORM (^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$).
PASS - Domain events are frozen dataclasses. Repository abstractions prevent direct ORM access from application/domain layers. No business logic bypasses.
PASS - CSRF middleware globally enabled. No debug endpoints exposed. No secrets in source files.
PASS - django-markdownx 4.0.11 is current. django-q2 1.10.0 is current. No known CVEs for installed versions.
PASS - Blog is read-only for public. Admin creates content only via Django admin (session auth). Draft access now restricted to is_staff.

owaspFindings.category: A08 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
owaspFindings.finding: PASS - Django Q2 tasks enqueue trusted functions only. No deserialization of untrusted data.

owaspFindings.category: A09 - Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
owaspFindings.finding: PASS - Vectorization failures are logged with logger.exception including post id. Schedule_vectorization failures are caught and logged. No silent failure paths.
PASS - No SSRF vectors. External calls (OpenAI, Supabase) use hardcoded SDK endpoints loaded from settings, not user-supplied URLs.

knownAcceptedRisks.description: post_detail.html renders post.body with the Django |safe filter (no HTML escaping). This is intentional: body is authored exclusively by admin users via Django admin. A compromised admin account could inject XSS. Acceptable for a personal portfolio with a single admin. Mitigated by Django admin login requirements and CSRF protection.
knownAcceptedRisks.acceptanceRationale: Admin-only content. Trust boundary is the Django admin session. Consistent with KI-001 deferral.

bottlenecks.description: N+1 author resolution in ListPublishedPosts: _resolve_author_name issues one User.objects.get() call per post on the list page. For a personal portfolio blog with O(10) posts per page this is negligible, but will degrade as the post count grows.
bottlenecks.recommendation: Future: pass author display names through the repository query using select_related('author') and resolve the name in DjangoPostRepository._model_to_post_entity instead of the use case.

bottlenecks.description: post_list view constructs a Paginator over range(total) to generate a page_obj for pagination controls. This is a Django idiom for custom querysets and adds no measurable overhead.

performanceSummary.baseline: All 100 tests complete in under 53 seconds on a local development machine (including Django setup overhead). Individual page response times are expected to be under 100ms for a cached blog with O(10-100) posts.

domain.notes: Zero Django imports confirmed. All 82 unit tests run without Django setup - confirmed by test execution time (0.40s for unit tests vs 52s total with Django setup for integration tests).

application.notes: One Django import in use_cases.py (get_user_model for author name resolution) - documented as an accepted exception in the development-to-qa artifact. DTOs are frozen dataclasses with no business logic. No ORM queries in application layer.

infrastructure.notes: ORM models contain no business logic. Signal handlers delegate to domain services (ReadingTimeCalculator). Repositories translate ORM exceptions to domain exceptions. Featured image path uses FeaturedImagePath value object.

adapter.notes: Views instantiate repositories and use cases only. No direct ORM queries in views. Http404 raised at adapter boundary on PostNotFoundError. RSS feed uses use case DTOs.

knownLimitationsLog.description: Rich text editor in Django admin defaults to plain Textarea. Post body is stored as plain text/markdown. post_detail.html renders body with |safe (HTML passthrough). Until the markdownify filter is wired, body renders as raw text in the browser. Deferred to frontend/integration phase.
Post.author is nullable at the ORM level. Admin creates posts without auto-assigning author to request.user. Posts authored by null author_id will show 'Unknown Author' in public views. Deferred.
Django Q2 vectorization task failure is logged but dead-letter strategy (max_attempts, retry schedule) is not explicitly configured. Deferred.
